
gpu/gpu-dma-rdlen
R display hold-off poll blocks, four times (cycles, from CHCR2's store to the poll's end; Timer 2 at the system clock / 8) and
the poll's turns, of reads of 256 x h at (0,256) by DMA2 in 16-word blocks. Polls: T CHCR2 back to back, S + a Timer 2 read and
two RAM stores, N + 40 nops; hold-off: DRAM_CTRL bits 0-2 = 0 or 6. No assertions.
